run_iter_based_training: run the IterBasedRunner with data loaders and a workflow list to train a model iteration by iteration
resume_checkpoint: resume the IterBasedRunner from a saved checkpoint file with optimizer state restored
save_checkpoint: save the IterBasedRunner model and optimizer state to a checkpoint file with metadata
register_training_hooks: register default training hooks for the IterBasedRunner including lr, momentum, and checkpoint config
create_iter_loader: create an IterLoader wrapping a DataLoader to iterate continuously across epochs with deadlock prevention
